Name: Run Hosted MCP ADK Agent
Author: cbf81976-f755-4f3f-83fd-a1b7e124ac7f
Description: Launches an orchestration-tier Google ADK Agent integrated with a Google-hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server toolset. The action equips the agent with dynamic, self-refreshing OAuth credentials and billing headers to query security toolsets and fetch procedural guidance (Skills/Runbooks) from Google Cloud Storage. Upon completion, the agent's reasoning steps, executed tool call parameters (truncated to 120 characters to prevent PII exposure), and  final findings are consolidated into a single, clean Markdown report card on the Case Wall.
